title: Authority.description
description: This property represents a free text Description of the Public Service. The description is likely to be the text that potential users of the Public Service see in any public service catalogue. Public administrations are encouraged to include a reasonable level of detail in the description, for instance including basic eligibility requirements for the particular Public Service and contact information. Rich Text (HTML) is allowed. Note: must not contain executable (JavaScript) code and anchor tags with relative urls.
